remarks: Exceptional rental opportunity in a sought-after Stamford location. Set on a beautifully landscaped .23-acre property, this charming four-bedroom Cape-style Colonial offers generous living space, a flexible floor plan, and a private backyard. An entry vestibule with coat closet and nearby powder room opens to the living room with recessed lighting and bay window. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, pantry and a breakfast bar, and flows into the dining area with sliders to an expansive deck. A den off the kitchen and a sunroom provide additional space to relax, work, or entertain. The first-floor primary suite features an updated bath and is well suited for one-level living, guests, multigenerational living, or a caregiver arrangement. A laundry/mudroom that can also serve as a home office is located off the attached two-car garage.  Upstairs are three spacious bedrooms and an updated full bath. Additional features include hardwood floors throughout the home, newer first-floor ductless A/C units, and an unfinished basement with ample storage. A rare combination of space, privacy, versatility, and convenience, with easy access to shopping, dining, transportation, and all that Stamford has to offer. Available unfurnished or partially furnished.
